heading: Definitions

tree.text: the term “Administration” means the Small Business Administration;
the term “Administrator” means the Administrator of the Small Business Administration;
the term “control” means exercising the power to make policy decisions concerning a business;
the term “Council” means the National Women’s Business Council, established under section 7105 of this title;
the term “Interagency Committee” means the Interagency Committee on Women’s Business Enterprise, established under section 7101 of this title;
the term “operate” means being actively involved in the day-to-day management of a business;

children.text: a business or businesses owned by a woman or a group of women; or
the establishment, maintenance, or development of a business or businesses by a woman or a group of women; and

tree.text: the term “women-owned business” means a small business which a woman or a group of women—

children.text: own not less than 51 percent of the business.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 100–533, title IV, § 408, as added Pub. L. 103–403, title IV, § 413, Oct. 22, 1994, 108 Stat. 4197.)
